entities.name: Salhab Mammadov

entities.summary: Salhab Isa oghlu Mammadov is an Azerbaijani sculptor-painter, vice-rector of the Azerbaijan State Academy of Fine Arts, first deputy chairman of the Union of Artists of Azerbaijan, professor, People's Artist of Azerbaijan (2006).
